result.title: OT-CAL: Optimal-Transport-Guided Adaptive Sample Selection for Efficient Visual Learning
result.comment: 9 pages, 3 figures. Submitted to the IEEE BigData 2026 Workshop on Efficient AI
result.summary: Deep neural networks for image recognition are typically trained using mini-batches, with a forward pass to compute predictions and losses followed by a more computationally expensive backward pass to update model parameters. However, not all training samples contribute equally to learning, suggesting that computation can be reduced by performing backward passes only on informative samples. The challenge is that sample informativeness changes throughout training: difficult samples may be valuable early on, improving samples become important later, and class diversity becomes increasingly relevant toward the end. Existing methods often rely on fixed selection rules or computationally expensive per-sample gradient calculations. We propose OT-CAL, an adaptive data selection method that automatically adjusts its sampling preferences during training. OT-CAL represents each sample using five informativeness features, including difficulty, learnability, and uncertainty. A curriculum vector describes the currently preferred sample characteristics, and optimal-transport-based matching assigns selection weights according to how closely samples match this target. The curriculum vector is then updated using the selected samples, forming a feedback loop that adapts without a manually defined schedule. Experiments on three standard visual learning benchmarks show that, when selecting 50% of each mini-batch, OT-CAL improves performance by 1.3--2.1 points over AdaSelection while achieving 1.18--1.24 times faster training than full-data training.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 OT-CAL：用难度、可学性、不确定性等五个信息量特征刻画样本，以课程向量表述当前偏好的样本特性，并通过最优传输匹配分配样本选择权重，仅对部分样本做反向传播，从而在视觉分类训练中自适应调整选择偏好并提速。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「特征表示—目标课程向量—最优传输匹配—反馈更新」机制是纯训练侧的样本筛选，与推理期 latent 状态无直接关系，但其按信息量与可靠性动态分配计算与监督的思路，可能可供核查用于 LVR 中视觉证据筛选或轨迹训练监督的贡献分配。
